paper.title_en: Slow rotation of a localized Kalb-Ramond wormhole: Wald charges and fractional quadrupolar hair
paper.abstract_en: We construct an action-consistent slow-rotation branch, through second order, for a traversable wormhole supported by a phantom scalar, a scalar-localized radial string sector, and a Kalb-Ramond two-form coupled nonminimally to both the Ricci scalar and Ricci tensor. For the regular benchmark branch, covariant asymptotic analysis shows a vanishing ADM mass, while the first-order axial mode carries finite Iyer-Wald angular momentum. The nonminimal contributions to the angular charge decay at infinity, so the covariant and metric definitions of angular momentum agree. At second order, no nonzero mass correction is resolved; at fixed asymptotic scalar charge, rotation increases the throat area and makes the throat oblate. The most distinctive result arises in the quadrupolar sector. A long-range polar Kalb-Ramond response couples to the localized background and generates a matter-supported metric tail that decays more slowly than the ordinary vacuum quadrupole. The same noninteger hierarchy appears in curvature and reduces the differentiability of the conformal completion at spatial infinity. Consequently, the Geroch-Hansen and asymptotically Cartesian mass-centered quadrupole constructions are not applicable in their standard smooth form to this branch, even though its global mass and angular-momentum charges remain well defined. This separates charge-level asymptotic flatness from smooth multipolar asymptotics and identifies fractional Kalb-Ramond hair as the leading rotational quadrupolar signature of the benchmark solution.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文构建了Kalb-Ramond虫洞的慢旋转近似，并发现了分数四极毛发，涉及广义相对论基础中的渐近平坦性和多极矩概念。
decision.title_zh: 局域Kalb-Ramond虫洞的慢旋转：Wald电荷与分数四极毛发
decision.abstract_zh: 我们通过第二阶构建了一个与作用量一致的慢旋转分支，用于由幻影标量、标量局域径向弦扇区和与Ricci标量和Ricci张量均非最小耦合的Kalb-Ramond二阶张量支持的可穿越虫洞。对于正则基准分支，协变渐近分析显示ADM质量为零，而一阶轴性模式携带有限的Iyer-Wald角动量。角动量的非最小贡献在无穷远衰减，因此角动量的协变和度规定义一致。在第二阶，没有解析出非零质量修正；在固定渐近标量电荷下，旋转增加喉部面积并使喉部变得扁球状。最显著的结果出现在四极扇区。长程极向Kalb-Ramond响应耦合到局域背景，并产生一个物质支持的度规尾部，其衰减速度比普通真空四极慢。相同的非整数层级出现在曲率中，并降低了空间无穷远共形完备的可微性。因此，Geroch-Hansen和渐近笛卡尔质心四极构造不适用于该分支的标准光滑形式，尽管其整体质量和角动量电荷仍然定义良好。这将电荷层面的渐近平坦性与光滑多极渐近性区分开来，并将分数Kalb-Ramond毛发确定为基准解的领头旋转四极特征。
